headline: Media firms see revenue growth while gaming shows mixed results and education balances AI investment with cost cuts.

industries.summary: Disney reported $25,248 million revenue, up 7%, and is expanding AI partnerships with Adobe. Versant added $530 million acquisition and grew platform revenue to $245 million. Overall sentiment is positive with expanding IT spend.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and strong AI partnership

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Disney and Adobe are building custom generative AI models for parks and ESPN; other firms expand digital platforms.

industries.it_note: IT teams should focus on supporting AI model development and platform integration.

industries.summary: Caesars generated $2,940 million revenue but posted a $123 million loss. Bally's grew revenue 22% to $807.6 million. Light & Wonder kept a 29.4% margin but saw revenue fall 2%. IT spend is mixed across firms.

themes.title: Digital platform rebuild
themes.detail: Investments in iGaming, sports betting and new FAST channels drive modest revenue growth.

industries.it_note: Balance between platform upgrades and cost‑cutting; prioritize stable iGaming infrastructure.

industries.summary: Pearson posted $1,779 million revenue with a 14.2% margin and AI initiatives. Wolters Kluwer expanded AI tools but gave no revenue figure. Scholastic missed revenue at $216.8 million and recorded a -42.5% margin.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and positive AI focus

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Pearson and Wolters Kluwer roll out AI tutors, tax‑prep tools and regional AI expansions.

industries.it_note: IT teams should enable AI‑driven content creation and localized deployments.

industries.summary: Pearson reported $1,779 million revenue and AI‑focused growth. NYU secured $29.2 million and $30 million for a quantum lab. SLU announced custodial staff layoffs, indicating cost tightening.

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Pearson pilots AI tutors; NYU receives city funding for quantum research.

industries.it_note: Support AI tutoring platforms while monitoring cost‑reduction impacts.
